messages.subject: For Alexandre L'Heureux | Infrastructure, government relations and sustainability leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Weber,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Alexandre L'Heureux, President and Chief Executive Officer.

WSP's global infrastructure, energy and public-sector advisory portfolio operates at the intersection of governments, communities, sustainability commitments and major capital programs. That is closely aligned with the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and translate external commitments into accountable internal action across corporate and technical teams.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this experience might support WSP's government-relations, sustainability, stakeholder or country-strategy priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to WSP Global.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
